title: Kit reference shapes
description: Editor-schema companions to Kit references. String capability configuration fields accept kit.args and kit.env references before create-time expansion; numeric and boolean fields accept whole kit.args references. Effective configurations validate against the literal grammar.

whole.description: A string that is exactly one ${{ kit.args.<name> }} reference. Whole-value references adopt the arg's type at create (SPEC-v3 §6).

bearing.description: A string containing a kit.args or kit.env reference. Environment values remain strings and use the final container environment.
